name: wrench_works
title: BeamNG Wrench Works
tagline: Take the car apart and build it back, part by part
description: A hands-on garage for West Coast USA and Utah. Drive into one of four garages onto a working lift, click parts off the car and back on, tune, paint and repair, order parts for delivery or buy them over the counter at seven shops in town. Parts with options are chosen in one place, a radio plays your own music, and you can add garages and shops to any map. Nothing reloads while you work.
author: Connor Moyle
